corners.line: You can't be cooler than the corners
corners.linePrev: You fuckin' dorks ain't a source of the art
corners.lineNext: Where you source all your parts

stanza: And we are here to let you take advantage
Of our lack of craft
Certain streets have certain corners
Sooner or later we'll turn yours

corners.songTitle: Here I Dreamt I Was an Architect
corners.line: But the angles and the corners
stanza: And I am nothing of a builder
But here I dreamt I was an architect
And I built this balustrade
To keep you home, to keep you safe
From the outside world
But the angles and the corners
Even though my work is unparalleled
They never seemed to meet
This structure fell about our feet
And we were free to go
Looking out the door, I see the rain
Fall upon the funeral mourners
Parading in a wake of sad relations
As their shoes fill up with water
Maybe I'm too young
To keep good love from going wrong
But tonight you're on my mind
So you'll never know
